status: Coverage design reviewed; formal encodings and executions pending
scope: Current 674-row baseline plus explicitly separate supplementary families; not a fixed test-count completeness claim.

engine_semantics.HermiT: Reviewed OWL 2 DL mapping and fixed import closure; no unique-name assumption; absence of a statement is not negation. Non-entailment uses consistency of the ontology plus the negation of the candidate conclusion, or an independently checked countermodel.
engine_semantics.SHACL: W3C SHACL Recommendation 20 July 2017; graph and shapes digests, declared target population and inference/materialization policy. Core and SPARQL components recorded separately. Validation failure, timeout and engine error are never conformance.

execution_policy: PASS requires an implemented reviewed oracle, matching expected/observed result and readable receipt. NOT_APPLICABLE requires reason, reviewer and replacement evidence where the claim remains in scope. ERROR, TIMEOUT, BLOCKED and NOT_RUN are not passes. A negative case passes only when the intended rule is detected and unrelated defects are excluded.

constraint_dispositions.source_statement: Case identity is preserved across descriptions, scores, owners and administrative states. Equal labels do not establish case identity.
constraint_dispositions.owl_route: Partial: test absence of label-based equality and intended separation; do not infer inequality from different names.
constraint_dispositions.shacl_route: Partial: explicit identifiers and references can be checked; real-world case identity needs review.
constraint_dispositions.outside_engine_obligation: Review case-continuity policy and legitimate identity merges.
constraint_dispositions.positive_case: Two entries and two different cases with equal labels remain representable.
constraint_dispositions.prohibited_case: A mapping that merges cases from equal labels is rejected.
constraint_dispositions.non_entailment_case: Do not entail sameAs solely from an equal label or score.

constraint_dispositions.source_statement: A scenario, consequence statement, signal, plan or report alone must not create actual occurrences, outcomes, controls or effectiveness assertions.
constraint_dispositions.owl_route: Partial: test non-entailment of existence or realization from documentary classes alone.
constraint_dispositions.shacl_route: Partial: check declared assertion origin; graph validation cannot establish that an occurrence happened.
constraint_dispositions.outside_engine_obligation: Review evidence for actual occurrence, outcome, control and effectiveness assertions.
constraint_dispositions.positive_case: A scenario and a report can be recorded without asserting an actual occurrence.
constraint_dispositions.prohibited_case: A mapping or application that creates an occurrence solely from a report fails.
constraint_dispositions.non_entailment_case: Description membership alone does not entail an actual occurrence, outcome or effective control.

constraint_dispositions.source_statement: Issued semantic content and effective dependency versions are immutable. Correction and supersession create lineage-preserving new versions.
constraint_dispositions.owl_route: Not applicable to change prevention: monotonic axioms do not enforce immutability across transactions.
constraint_dispositions.shacl_route: Partial: check version links and required snapshot references within one graph.
constraint_dispositions.outside_engine_obligation: Application history test: change an issued payload, reject overwrite and create a new version with lineage.
constraint_dispositions.positive_case: A corrected new version preserves the old issued payload and dependency versions.
constraint_dispositions.prohibited_case: An in-place change to an issued payload is rejected by the application.
constraint_dispositions.non_entailment_case: Supersession does not entail deletion or replacement of historical content.

constraint_dispositions.source_statement: Results retain method/scale version, dimension, basis, relevant context and time semantics. A score is not the risk, and estimated likelihood need not be numeric.
constraint_dispositions.owl_route: Partial: map result types and reference links without reducing risk to a number.
constraint_dispositions.shacl_route: Partial: task-ready shapes require task-specific pinned method, scale, dimension, basis and time.
constraint_dispositions.outside_engine_obligation: Review measurement interpretation and qualitative likelihood; scalar fields still need an approved schema.
constraint_dispositions.positive_case: A qualitative result retains its context and interpretation without a numeric likelihood.
constraint_dispositions.prohibited_case: Task-ready admission fails when a required task input is missing.
constraint_dispositions.non_entailment_case: Equal numeric results alone do not entail case equality or comparability.

constraint_dispositions.source_statement: Recorded time, reference time and validity intervals are distinct. Workflow closure does not prove risk cessation or successful treatment.
constraint_dispositions.owl_route: Partial: test that administrative state does not entail cessation or effectiveness.
constraint_dispositions.shacl_route: Partial: check distinct temporal fields and interval ordering after the datatype schema is approved.
constraint_dispositions.outside_engine_obligation: Application and semantic review define time zones, unknown endpoints and cessation evidence.
constraint_dispositions.positive_case: Closing an entry preserves its recorded, reference and validity times separately.
constraint_dispositions.prohibited_case: A pipeline equating closure with cessation is rejected.
constraint_dispositions.non_entailment_case: A closed state alone entails neither cessation nor successful treatment.

constraint_dispositions.source_statement: An asserted ResponsibilityRelator requires at least two distinct mediated individuals. If bearer and authority resolve to one actor and no further grounding exists, retain ResponsibilityAssignmentInformation without asserting the relator.
constraint_dispositions.owl_route: Partial: reviewed mediation axioms can require distinct participants; missing named witnesses are not an OWL inconsistency.
constraint_dispositions.shacl_route: Planned: SHACL-SPARQL checks resolved participant distinctness using an explicit identity-normalization policy.
constraint_dispositions.outside_engine_obligation: Resolve alias/sameAs identity before counting actors; do not manufacture authority or a second actor.
constraint_dispositions.positive_case: An information assignment may exist alone; a grounded mandate has two distinct participants.
constraint_dispositions.prohibited_case: A managed relator whose bearer and authority resolve to the same sole actor is rejected.
constraint_dispositions.non_entailment_case: Assignment information alone does not entail an actual mandate or a second distinct actor.

constraint_dispositions.source_statement: ResponsibleAgentRole does not automatically mean Risk Owner. Ownership mapping requires recorded responsibility type, accountability, authority and applicable context.
constraint_dispositions.owl_route: Partial: role membership must not entail an unjustified ownership classification.
constraint_dispositions.shacl_route: Partial: require recorded role, authority, accountability and context for an ownership mapping.
constraint_dispositions.outside_engine_obligation: Review what constitutes ownership evidence; the current model has no approved global RiskOwner class.
constraint_dispositions.positive_case: A responsible actor is recorded without asserting ownership.
constraint_dispositions.prohibited_case: An ownership claim with missing qualifying evidence is rejected at its admission boundary.
constraint_dispositions.non_entailment_case: ResponsibleAgentRole membership alone does not entail Risk Owner status.

constraint_dispositions.source_statement: At least one of thresholdForIndicator or thresholdOnScale is present. If both are present, their scale/unit interpretation is compatible. Qualitative boundaries use scale semantics rather than invented numeric units.
constraint_dispositions.owl_route: Partial: an anchor disjunction may be encoded after review; missing explicit data remains an open-world issue.
constraint_dispositions.shacl_route: Planned: Core sh:or for indicator or scale, plus SPARQL compatibility checks after unit/scale schema review.
constraint_dispositions.outside_engine_obligation: Review qualitative scale semantics and any governed conversion.
constraint_dispositions.positive_case: Indicator-only, scale-only and compatible dual-anchor thresholds are accepted.
constraint_dispositions.prohibited_case: No-anchor and incompatible dual-anchor task-ready thresholds are rejected.
constraint_dispositions.non_entailment_case: A scale-only threshold does not entail a fabricated indicator or numeric unit.

constraint_dispositions.source_statement: Every published RiskDescription has at least one case, pattern or scenario target. Multiple valid targets are permitted and require explicit interpretation.
constraint_dispositions.owl_route: Partial: an existential aboutness disjunction may be mapped, but publication completeness is a graph policy.
constraint_dispositions.shacl_route: Planned: Core alternativePath over describesCase, describesPattern and expressesScenario with minCount 1.
constraint_dispositions.outside_engine_obligation: Select the published-description profile and document multiple-target interpretation.
constraint_dispositions.positive_case: A published description with one or several justified targets is admitted.
constraint_dispositions.prohibited_case: A published description without any permitted target is rejected.
constraint_dispositions.non_entailment_case: Multiple targets do not imply that case, pattern and scenario have the same identity.

constraint_dispositions.source_statement: Tolerance statements retain source framework/version, original meaning and context. Permissible deviation is not automatically equivalent to readiness to bear remaining risk.
constraint_dispositions.owl_route: Partial: preserve separate statement resources without asserting a global equivalence of tolerance meanings.
constraint_dispositions.shacl_route: Partial: require source framework/version and context once provenance properties are approved.
constraint_dispositions.outside_engine_obligation: Review source-specific meanings and inspected source portions.
constraint_dispositions.positive_case: Two frameworks with distinct tolerance meanings remain separately traceable.
constraint_dispositions.prohibited_case: A mapping equating those meanings from their labels alone is rejected.
constraint_dispositions.non_entailment_case: Equal tolerance labels do not entail equivalent meaning or equivalentClass.

constraint_dispositions.source_statement: Vocabulary resources retain scheme-qualified identity. Labels are representations and are not OWL classes by default.
constraint_dispositions.owl_route: Partial: vocabulary individuals are not generated as OWL classes or equality axioms from labels.
constraint_dispositions.shacl_route: Planned: scheme membership, resource identity and label-data validation using an approved vocabulary profile.
constraint_dispositions.outside_engine_obligation: Review scheme identifiers and legitimate cross-scheme mappings.
constraint_dispositions.positive_case: The same label in two schemes can denote two resources.
constraint_dispositions.prohibited_case: A transformation that creates a global class or merges resources solely from a label fails.
constraint_dispositions.non_entailment_case: Equal labels across schemes do not entail sameAs or class equivalence.

constraint_dispositions.source_statement: EvidenceReference states an evidential role such as support, challenge or context. Linking a source does not automatically prove the target claim.
constraint_dispositions.owl_route: Partial: evidential links alone must not entail truth or endorsement of the target claim.
constraint_dispositions.shacl_route: Partial: require support/challenge/context qualification and source locators after the assertion schema is reviewed.
constraint_dispositions.outside_engine_obligation: Review evidential adequacy independently of presence or graph conformance.
constraint_dispositions.positive_case: Support and challenge references coexist without a truth verdict.
constraint_dispositions.prohibited_case: An evidential link automatically reported as proof is rejected.
constraint_dispositions.non_entailment_case: Source linkage alone does not entail that its target claim is true.

constraint_dispositions.source_statement: A selected level belongs to the selected scale version and dimension. Results on incompatible methods/scales are not ranked merely by equal labels or numeric codes.
constraint_dispositions.owl_route: Partial: typed relationships can be represented; arbitrary joins across scale/version/dimension are not assumed expressible.
constraint_dispositions.shacl_route: Planned: SPARQL checks selected level, scale version and dimension against pinned interpretation.
constraint_dispositions.outside_engine_obligation: Review unit conversion, dimensions and missing-version policy.
constraint_dispositions.positive_case: A selected level with matching scale version and dimension is accepted.
constraint_dispositions.prohibited_case: A level from another scale/version or dimension fails task-ready admission.
constraint_dispositions.non_entailment_case: Equal codes or labels do not entail compatibility or ranking.

constraint_dispositions.source_statement: RiskSource, Consequence and RiskControl remain catalog notions and optional external boundaries, excluded from native formal-core class assertions. Source, outcome and control content is represented by RiskSourceReference, ConsequenceStatement and ControlReference.
constraint_dispositions.owl_route: Planned: reject typed-core declarations for the three excluded catalog boundaries in the export.
constraint_dispositions.shacl_route: Planned: boundary-admission checks reject using those catalog notions as managed core classes.
constraint_dispositions.outside_engine_obligation: Record optional external bridges separately; adding an external ontology requires a new ownership decision.
constraint_dispositions.positive_case: References and statements remain typed while the three heterogeneous boundaries remain outside core.
constraint_dispositions.prohibited_case: An export silently promoting an excluded boundary to a typed core class is rejected.
constraint_dispositions.non_entailment_case: A source, consequence or control reference alone does not entail an actual referent.

constraint_dispositions.source_statement: Every asserted intrinsic Vulnerability has exactly one substantial-endurant bearer. A reported hypothesis alone is information, not an actual mode.
constraint_dispositions.owl_route: Partial: reviewed characterization mapping can express exactly one bearer; name equality and missing names need separate treatment.
constraint_dispositions.shacl_route: Planned: inverse bearsVulnerability count 1 with a substantial-object target check after anchor mapping.
constraint_dispositions.outside_engine_obligation: Review whether a source warrants an actual intrinsic mode; external kind owns bearer identity.
constraint_dispositions.positive_case: A justified vulnerability with exactly one substantial object bearer is accepted.
constraint_dispositions.prohibited_case: A managed vulnerability with zero or two resolved distinct bearers is rejected.
constraint_dispositions.non_entailment_case: A reported hypothesis alone does not entail an actual intrinsic vulnerability.

constraint_dispositions.source_statement: Raw source content is retained in staging. Managed records require identity, subject, title and provenance. Analytical readiness additionally requires the pinned context, method, scale, basis, dimension and time required for the selected task.
constraint_dispositions.owl_route: Not applicable to explicit-data completeness: OWL inference is not a record-admission decision.
constraint_dispositions.shacl_route: Planned: separate raw, managed and task-ready shapes; never run a managed requirement as raw rejection.
constraint_dispositions.outside_engine_obligation: Approve required identity, title and provenance properties and task-specific input sets.
constraint_dispositions.positive_case: Incomplete source content remains raw; a complete record can be admitted under its declared profile.
constraint_dispositions.prohibited_case: A raw incomplete record labeled managed or task-ready without required evidence is rejected.
constraint_dispositions.non_entailment_case: Retaining raw content does not entail analytical readiness.

constraint_dispositions.source_statement: Multiple classifications, descriptions, actors and evidence assertions are retained with role, context, provenance and time. Scalar export requires an explicit selection rule when several values apply.
constraint_dispositions.owl_route: Partial: multiple assertions must remain consistent without unsupported functional properties or identity keys.
constraint_dispositions.shacl_route: Partial: check qualified assertion context, time and provenance after schema review.
constraint_dispositions.outside_engine_obligation: Application export test: multiple applicable values require a declared scalar selection rule.
constraint_dispositions.positive_case: Two conflicting, qualified assertions are retained with their provenance.
constraint_dispositions.prohibited_case: A scalar export silently choosing one assertion without a rule is rejected.
constraint_dispositions.non_entailment_case: Conflicting source assertions do not automatically entail equality or independent corroboration.

constraint_dispositions.source_statement: Direct comparison requires matching pinned method, scale, dimension, basis and temporal context; a governed explicit transformation may enable a different comparison. Missing data is not zero. Reported scores do not imply a reproducible computation.
constraint_dispositions.owl_route: Partial: test absence of comparability entailments from equal numbers or labels.
constraint_dispositions.shacl_route: Planned: SPARQL task-readiness joins over pinned method, scale, dimension, basis and temporal context.
constraint_dispositions.outside_engine_obligation: Application calculation/comparison tests cover governed transformations and missing values.
constraint_dispositions.positive_case: Matching pinned contexts or an explicitly governed transformation permit only the declared comparison.
constraint_dispositions.prohibited_case: Missing context treated as zero or an unsupported comparison is rejected.
constraint_dispositions.non_entailment_case: A reported score does not entail reproducible calculation or direct comparability.

constraint_dispositions.source_statement: State labels are scheme/version qualified. Transition rules and authority are source-backed content. Missing rule means UNKNOWN; Closed does not imply ceased risk and Treated does not imply effectiveness.
constraint_dispositions.owl_route: Partial: scheme-qualified workflow state does not entail actual risk cessation or effectiveness.
constraint_dispositions.shacl_route: Partial: validate scheme/version references and source-backed transition-rule records.
constraint_dispositions.outside_engine_obligation: Application transition tests enforce authority; absent rules yield UNKNOWN, not automatic permission.
constraint_dispositions.positive_case: A state record with an unknown transition rule is retained as UNKNOWN.
constraint_dispositions.prohibited_case: An unauthorized transition or a fabricated effectiveness conclusion is rejected.
constraint_dispositions.non_entailment_case: Closed does not entail ceased risk; Treated does not entail effectiveness.

constraint_dispositions.source_statement: In the terminology adopted by this profile, Risk Item denotes the managed risk subject modeled as RiskCase. This context-qualified mapping does not equate RiskCase with RiskRegisterEntry, RiskScenarioSpecification, ISO risk or any global Risk Item class.
constraint_dispositions.owl_route: Planned: no global RiskItem class equivalence, case-entry identity or scenario-case equivalence is introduced.
constraint_dispositions.shacl_route: Partial: validate context-qualified vocabulary mapping records, not truth of their meaning.
constraint_dispositions.outside_engine_obligation: Review local vocabulary attribution and reject extension of its scope to global standards.
constraint_dispositions.positive_case: The local Risk Item label denotes the case only within the declared profile.
constraint_dispositions.prohibited_case: A mapping equating case with entry, scenario or global Risk Item is rejected.
constraint_dispositions.non_entailment_case: A local vocabulary mapping does not entail a global equivalentClass axiom.

constraint_dispositions.source_statement: A reported RiskScoreResult may have no derivedFrom links. A computed RiskScoreResult requires at least one linked DimensionAssessmentResult, a pinned method and adequate inputs. The score kind must be recorded.
constraint_dispositions.owl_route: Partial: represent result and input relationships without treating a missing triple as proof of inconsistency.
constraint_dispositions.shacl_route: Planned: conditional reported/computed shapes require derivedFrom, pinned method and adequate inputs for computed results.
constraint_dispositions.outside_engine_obligation: Application tests rerun the formula; score-kind and formula/input scalar schema still need review.
constraint_dispositions.positive_case: A reported result may lack derivedFrom; a computed result has justified linked inputs and method.
constraint_dispositions.prohibited_case: A result labeled computed with missing required inputs fails task-ready admission.
constraint_dispositions.non_entailment_case: A supplied score alone does not entail verified computation.

constraint_dispositions.source_statement: Repeated mandates between the same participants are permitted when grounding assignment, responsibility scope or validity differs. Duplicate representations of the same grounded mandate must resolve to one relator identity; participant equality alone is not an identity key.
constraint_dispositions.owl_route: Partial: do not use the participant pair as a global OWL key for mandate identity.
constraint_dispositions.shacl_route: Partial: check grounding, scope and validity fields; identity resolution remains application-governed.
constraint_dispositions.outside_engine_obligation: Application identity tests merge duplicate representations of one grounded mandate while retaining renewed mandates.
constraint_dispositions.positive_case: Two mandates between the same actors can differ by grounding, scope or validity.
constraint_dispositions.prohibited_case: Merging all mandates solely from equal participants or retaining a known duplicate as new fails.
constraint_dispositions.non_entailment_case: Equal participants alone do not entail identical mandates.

constraint_dispositions.source_statement: Every analyzedInContext link is also a hasContext link for the same RiskCase and RiskContextSpecification. The broader hasContext relation may include non-analysis context.
constraint_dispositions.owl_route: Planned: analyzedInContext is a subproperty of hasContext; the reverse is not asserted.
constraint_dispositions.shacl_route: Planned: explicit-data coherence check requires matching hasContext for each analyzedInContext when no materialization is selected.
constraint_dispositions.outside_engine_obligation: Pin inference/materialization policy; never repair negative fixtures silently.
constraint_dispositions.positive_case: An analysis-context link entails the same broader context link in OWL.
constraint_dispositions.prohibited_case: A managed explicit graph missing its required matching hasContext link fails the declared shape.
constraint_dispositions.non_entailment_case: A hasContext link alone does not entail analyzedInContext.

constraint_dispositions.source_statement: For each EntryRevision, revisionOf and inherited versionOf identify the same RiskRegisterEntry. previousRevision is irreflexive and acyclic and, when present, relates revisions of the same entry.
constraint_dispositions.owl_route: Partial: reviewed subproperty mapping for revisionOf/versionOf is possible; unbounded cycle detection is outside the OWL contract.
constraint_dispositions.shacl_route: Planned: SPARQL tests equality of entry targets, previousRevision irreflexivity, transitive cycle absence and same-entry lineage.
constraint_dispositions.outside_engine_obligation: Application tests prevent historical payload overwrites and preserve revision history.
constraint_dispositions.positive_case: Two successive revisions of the same entry have matching versionOf and revisionOf targets.
constraint_dispositions.prohibited_case: Mismatched entry targets, self-loops, multi-step cycles and cross-entry previousRevision fail.
constraint_dispositions.non_entailment_case: A previousRevision link does not entail that unrelated entries are identical.

constraint_dispositions.source_statement: usesContextVersion targets a version of RiskContextSpecification; usesMethodVersion a version of AssessmentMethodSpecification; usesScaleVersion a version of AssessmentScale; usesCriteriaVersion a version of RiskCriteria. Artifact-level references, when present, agree with versionOf.
constraint_dispositions.owl_route: Partial: reviewed qualified version target restrictions may be encoded; arbitrary artifact/version joins remain explicit-data checks.
constraint_dispositions.shacl_route: Planned: SPARQL checks context/method/scale/criteria versionOf target type and agreement with artifact references.
constraint_dispositions.outside_engine_obligation: Pin which artifact-level references exist and which are optional before admitting data.
constraint_dispositions.positive_case: Each selected version belongs to the right artifact kind and agrees with any direct artifact reference.
constraint_dispositions.prohibited_case: A wrong-kind version or contradictory direct artifact reference fails task-ready admission.
constraint_dispositions.non_entailment_case: Version identity does not collapse into artifact identity or a current mutable version.

supplementary_families.name: Import closure and foundational anchor
supplementary_families.positive: Resolve the pinned foundational anchor and all imports; test its intended interpretation.
supplementary_families.negative: Missing, altered or unresolved imports fail reproducibility.
supplementary_families.boundary: Do not add the imported anchor to the 77 local typed-class denominator.

supplementary_families.name: Generalization sets, identity and role dependence
supplementary_families.positive: Review every sibling group for intended completeness, overlap/disjointness and identity/dependence.
supplementary_families.negative: Unreviewed disjointness, covering axioms or participant-based identity keys are rejected.
supplementary_families.boundary: An undeclared generalization set remains unspecified until a justified semantic decision exists.

supplementary_families.name: Optional external bridges
supplementary_families.positive: Keep all seven bridge dispositions visible outside the typed mapping.
supplementary_families.negative: Silent promotion into the typed core fails review.
supplementary_families.boundary: An excluded bridge is not a passed OWL relation test.

supplementary_families.name: Scope requirement acceptance
supplementary_families.positive: Execute each scope acceptance criterion using its own source contract.
supplementary_families.negative: Execute its negative acceptance criterion as a prohibited case.
supplementary_families.boundary: The eight scope obligations are additional to the twelve requirement families in the baseline.

supplementary_families.name: Cross-domain integration
supplementary_families.positive: Combine entry, case, scenario, assessment, version, evidence and responsibility in shared fixtures.
supplementary_families.negative: Detect wrong joins, case/record identity collapse and incompatible scale or version references.
supplementary_families.boundary: Pairwise endpoint coverage alone does not establish multi-domain answerability.

supplementary_families.name: Datatype, lexical and unit boundaries
supplementary_families.positive: Use reviewed datatypes, scale/unit semantics and valid lexical forms.
supplementary_families.negative: Malformed literals and incompatible units are rejected by the intended rule.
supplementary_families.boundary: Scalar vocabulary and conversion policy require approval before implementation.

supplementary_families.name: Unknown, conflicting and incomplete content
supplementary_families.positive: Retain qualified incomplete and conflicting assertions as raw content.
supplementary_families.negative: Reject false task readiness, silent scalar selection and conversion of missing values to zero.
supplementary_families.boundary: Conformance is reported for a named population and profile, never for all received data.

supplementary_families.name: Temporal and version history
supplementary_families.positive: Cover equal endpoints, open/unknown intervals, corrections and supersession.
supplementary_families.negative: Reject inverted intervals, cycles and overwriting issued semantic content.
supplementary_families.boundary: A static graph check does not establish transaction-level immutability.

supplementary_families.name: Duplicate identity and blank nodes
supplementary_families.positive: Normalize known identity aliases and test equivalent fixtures with supported blank nodes.
supplementary_families.negative: Reject fabricated actor distinctness, unintended merges and unsupported cross-run blank-node identity.
supplementary_families.boundary: RDF value-node counts and OWL individual distinctness are different notions.

supplementary_families.name: Mutation and clean rerun
supplementary_families.positive: Rerun pinned inputs in a clean environment with the same outcomes.
supplementary_families.negative: A controlled mutation triggers its intended rule; changed inputs invalidate old receipts.
supplementary_families.boundary: Fresh execution records are required; deterministic generation alone is not formal validation.

blockers_before_formal_execution: Native model and semantic review in issue #2.
Reviewed OWL mapping, names, imports and datatypes in issue #3.
Implemented oracles and fixtures in issues #4 and #5; query contracts in issue #6.
Independent domain and case interpretation remain separate evidence in issue #7.
